name: Elena
source: Mrs. Hinze's granddaughter, Elena is a stern, stand-off-ish woman. She appears to have a single-minded tenacity. That tenacity is directed at making certain the boarding house runs smoothly and that her grandmother is not troubled by any of the tenants.
